title: Add DemoWeaver to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [DemoWeaver](https://mebularts.github.io/DemoWeaver) to build
- DemoWeaver is an open-source AI-powered product walkthrough generator that turns a running web application into a browser-verified, professionally narrated product video. Instead of manually recording

Fixes #14070

gist.headline: Demos, woven fresh
gist.blurb: DemoWeaver joined the garden: a tool that watches a running web app and weaves its clicks into a browser-verified, narrated walkthrough video. Manual screen-recording rituals may now rest quietly.
gist.summary: Added DemoWeaver to the app build registry, making the open-source tool available for turning running web applications into browser-verified, professionally narrated product walkthrough videos.
gist.impact: Builders can discover and use DemoWeaver to create polished product demos from real browser interactions rather than assembling recordings by hand.
gist.visual_concept: Depict DemoWeaver as a cozy loom-like retro workstation that turns a small browser window and its click-path into a neatly woven film reel. Polli, wearing a tiny director beret, guides the thread while a CRT monitor robot happily watches the verified walkthrough; code-plants and flowers make the build feel like a community garden.
